caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical drum with a single drumstick resting diagonally across its top. The drum has a brown body and a surface that appears dark brown or black. Around the drum's midsection, there is a repeating pattern of colored triangles in yellow, red, green, and blue, arranged to form a band. The triangles are outlined in a thin, dark line. The drum has cords laced through its sides, with one cord hanging loosely off the right side. The drumstick has a cylindrical wooden handle and a rounded, beige or off-white tip. The drawing is centered on a plain, beige background with a border of lighter color surrounding the central image.
title: Drum
